# Company Facts


## About Alaska Airlines


Discover what makes Alaska Airlines among the leading and most beloved carriers in the U.S.


## About Hawaiian Airlines


Get to know Hawaiian Airlines, Hawaiʻi’s biggest and longest-serving carrier sharing aloha across the world.


## Learn more about us


### Fact sheet


Get an overview of Alaska Air Group, Inc. and its carriers’ nearly century-long legacy of connecting communities.


### Fleet


Learn more about the aircraft we proudly operate, flying our guests safely to destinations worldwide.


### Awards


Trusted by millions, honored across the industry — see what sets the carriers of Alaska Air Group apart.


### Atmos™ Rewards


Meet our loyalty program that delivers more choice, rewards and global access than ever before.


### Route map


Together, Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines offer even more destinations for our guests to discover.


### **one** world Alliance®


Say hi to the alliance of the world’s leading airlines providing the highest level of service and convenience.


### Guest experience


Whether for business or leisure, there’s a travel experience tailored toward our guests’ needs.


### Corporate impact


Read about our learnings and progress to steward our corporate impact responsibly as we grow.


### Alaska Star Ventures


We seek to enable technologies that empower the future of our company and industry for decades to come.
